stages.action: Select hands/controllers and preferred hand via same world UI, do not require gesture recognition to switch away from failed mode
One large practice button; near poke or controller select; feedback per event
Take badge then attach/return; holding state must become false before locomotion; skip only as assisted
Hands: demonstrate L-pose and arc. Alternative: explicit travel panel. Controller: scene-configured travel activation, not assumed SDK default
Valid nearby anchor + deliberate select/release. Confirm success via actual move acknowledgement, not input event only
Continue C01; no compulsory actual physical walking or turning

repeat_rule: Only incomplete step; no looping full speech on tracking reacquisition
failure_rule: Freeze tutorial timer on tracking loss; show recovery or input mode switch; do not mark full control test PASS from text
